items.headline: Bulldogs bury error-prone Dragons as Warriors and Manly headline Super Saturday
items.detail: Canterbury led 24-0 at the break and ran out 44-14 winners over St George Illawarra at Allianz Stadium, with Matt Burton scoring twice despite a sin-binning.

items.headline: Warriors surge to the top of the ladder with high-scoring win over Souths
items.detail: The Warriors beat South Sydney 45-26 at Accor Stadium for their 16th win, with Taine Tuaupiki kicking eight from eight and Luke Hanson's late field goal edging them one point clear of Penrith on for-and-against.

items.headline: Injury toll grows across the NRL with Koula and Tedesco among the casualties
items.detail: The latest casualty ward update lists Sione Katoa Koula with an ankle problem and James Tedesco still hampered as clubs manage bodies heading into the run home.

items.headline: Bulldogs edge Melbourne in a thriller to book a wildcard meeting with Collingwood
items.detail: The Western Bulldogs won a tight round 24 contest at the MCG, sending the Demons into an anxious wait over their own finals path.

items.headline: Geelong overpower Richmond to lock away a top-six finish and skip wildcard week
items.detail: The Cats thrashed the Tigers at GMHBA Stadium to secure a place inside the top six and earn a week off before finals.

items.headline: Naughton in a race against the clock as Bulldogs sweat on their key forward
items.detail: Aaron Naughton hurt a lateral ligament against Melbourne and is now under an injury cloud for the Wildcard Round.

items.headline: Wallaroos milestone Test spoiled as Black Ferns complete O'Reilly Cup clean sweep
items.detail: Australia's women marked their 100th Test with a defeat in Auckland, handing New Zealand a series sweep of the O'Reilly Cup.

items.headline: Kiss says the heat is on his Wallabies as the Rugby Championship bites
items.detail: Coach Joe Kiss acknowledged the mounting expectation on his squad as Australia prepares for the next stage of its Championship campaign.

items.headline: Kolisi sidelined for the opening Springboks-All Blacks Test in Johannesburg
items.detail: South Africa will be without their captain Siya Kolisi for the first of four straight Tests against New Zealand.

items.headline: McIlroy drops back at the BMW Championship after a modest second round
items.detail: The Northern Irishman followed his opening 64 with a 69 at Bellerive and headed straight to the range as Wyndham Clark took over the lead.

items.headline: McIlroy grabs a share of the opening lead in St Louis while Scheffler stumbles
items.detail: A six-under 64 put McIlroy top of the FedExCup playoff event as Scottie Scheffler made a nightmare start to round one.

items.headline: Westwood fires back at McIlroy over his dismissal of LIV players' worth
items.detail: The Englishman responded at LIV Golf Indianapolis, calling McIlroy's questioning of LIV stars' value to the PGA Tour 'typical'.

items.headline: DeChambeau admits the uncertainty over LIV Golf's future has been hard going
items.detail: The Crushers GC captain said he hopes the league gets one more chance despite acknowledging it has 'a lot against them' in securing funding.

items.headline: LIV Golf boss sets a funding deadline while talking up the league's prospects
items.detail: Chief executive Scott O'Neil said he remains optimistic but warned of a compressed timeline to lock in financial backing.

items.headline: Winther holds off compatriot Hojgaard to take the Danish Golf Championship
items.detail: Jeff Winther sealed a three-shot DP World Tour victory over fellow Dane Rasmus Hojgaard in a tense finish.

items.headline: Starc and Shoriful share the spoils in an 18-wicket opening day at Mackay
items.detail: Mitchell Starc took six and Shoriful Islam replied with six of his own as Australia bowled Bangladesh out for 64 before slipping to 165 for 8 in the second Test.

items.headline: Ponting says Australia should move on from Labuschagne after another failure
items.detail: The former captain argued it is 'well and truly time to look at somebody else' following Marnus Labuschagne's first-innings duck in Mackay.

items.headline: Trescothick fights for his England future after a crushing win over Pakistan
items.detail: England wrapped up the first Test by an innings and 103 runs at Headingley, but the assistant coach knows his role remains under review.

items.headline: Bo Nix looks sharp in his first outing since ankle surgery
items.detail: The Broncos quarterback returned in preseason week two after sitting out Denver's opener, as Green Bay went on to win 33-13.

items.headline: Jets shut out the Steelers as Will Howard is picked off twice
items.detail: New York blanked Pittsburgh 17-0, a notable turnaround for a team that failed to record a single interception across the whole of 2025.

items.headline: Raiders coach refuses to settle the quarterback race after a second preseason game
items.detail: Klint Kubiak said he needs 'another week' before choosing between Kirk Cousins and rookie Fernando Mendoza, who threw a pick six on his opening series.

items.headline: Harden heads back to Cleveland on a reported three-year contract
items.detail: The 11-time All-Star and 2018 MVP is said to have agreed a three-year, 97 million dollar deal with the Cavaliers.

items.headline: Peyton Watson lands at the Cavaliers in a sprawling five-team sign-and-trade
items.detail: Denver picked up a pair of future draft picks in the deal, while veteran Max Strus was routed to the Clippers.

items.headline: LeBron James commits to a record-extending 24th NBA season
items.detail: The league's all-time leading scorer will line up again in 2026-27, having already featured in 23 season openers.

items.headline: Misiorowski trims his league-leading ERA as Brewers squeeze past Atlanta
items.detail: Milwaukee won 2-1 in a pitching duel between the Brewers right-hander and Braves veteran Chris Sale, with both defences producing highlight plays.

items.headline: Devers answers the Fenway boos with a home run on his return to Boston
items.detail: The Giants slugger was jeered by Red Sox fans in his first game back at Fenway Park since the trade, then went deep.

items.headline: deGrom reaches 2,000 career strikeouts as Texas blanks Washington
items.detail: The Rangers ace hit the milestone in a 2-0 shutout win over the Nationals.

items.headline: Russell takes the Dutch GP Sprint to close on championship leader Antonelli
items.detail: The Mercedes driver converted Sprint pole into victory at Zandvoort ahead of Charles Leclerc, cutting his deficit to team-mate Kimi Antonelli.

items.headline: Antonelli set for a grid penalty on home soil at Monza
items.detail: Toto Wolff confirmed the championship leader will take an engine change penalty at the Italian Grand Prix.

items.headline: Verstappen says retirement was a likelier option than switching teams
items.detail: The Dutchman explained his new Red Bull deal, which runs to 2030, by saying he was closer to quitting the sport than moving elsewhere.

items.headline: Sinner pulls out of the US Open with a knee problem
items.detail: The world No 1 said he was 'very sad and disappointed' to miss the season's final Grand Slam.

items.headline: Gauff powers into the Cincinnati semi-finals in straight sets
items.detail: The American saw off Marta Kostyuk to reach the last four, keeping US hopes alive in both the men's and women's draws.

items.headline: Draper's injury lay-off rules him out of Flushing Meadows
items.detail: The British No 1 will miss the US Open as his ongoing fitness problems continue.
